fieldValues.title: Review: is the decision checklist helping the owner judge?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: First version written 2026-11-05 from the owner's meeting review, the muDemocracy guide, the handbook's four tests and srs#998. DC-01 to DC-11 follow the meeting's checklist; DC-12 to DC-14 are additions from srs#998 and have not been tried. This exercise stays open and on every owner session's agenda until three reviews in a row change nothing.
fieldValues.tensions:
Thorough against light: every check added is a cost on each decision, and DC-11 must keep small decisions small.
Mechanical against judgement: a check a tool can pass can be filled to pass (9b9f9434: form 97%, substance 41%).
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: At each session: Which decision was hardest to judge, and what was missing? Which check did you actually use? Which did nothing? Did you change or refuse a recommendation, and did a check prompt it? Record the answers as comments here, with any check changed.
fieldValues.next_action: Review at the next owner session, using srs#998 as the first test case: does its rewritten block let the owner say what they are judging?
